description.value:
You adopt a draconic aspect, granting you physical traits such as scaled skin, vertical pupils, and sharp nails.

You gain a darkvision range of 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, add 60 ft to its range.

As an Action, you can exhale destructive energy. All creatues in the area of effect take damage equal to a number of rolls of your Natural Weapons die equal to your Proficiency. The shape, Saving Throw, and damage type of your breath weapon is determined by your draconic form, which you choose when you gain this feature. You can find all available options in the table below. The DC for this is 8 + your Proficiency + your Constitution modifier. Once you have used your breath weapon, you have to roll a d6 at the start of each of your turns. On a roll of 5 or 6, you regain your use of this feature.

Once you reach level 10 in this class, the size of your breath weapon doubles.
